name: Cable Crunch
why: Crunch you can load and add weight to easily.
setup: Rope on a high pulley. Kneel facing it, hands by your face.
Let the weight pull your back into a slight arch.
form: Curl your ribs toward your hips, elbows to mid-thighs. Squeeze 1 s.
Uncurl slowly until your back arches again.
tips: Keep your hips still: the spine does the work.
avoid: Sitting back on your heels to move the weight.
rangeOfMotion: Back slightly arched → spine fully curled
tempo: Down 1 s · Hold 1 s · Up 3 s

preferred.why: Easy to load and progress, with a stretch at the top; rated the best ab exercise.

name: Seated Cable Crunch
why: Cable crunch done sitting on a bench.
setup: Sit on a bench, back to a high pulley.
Rope over your shoulders, hands by your chest.
form: Curl your ribs down toward your hips.
Uncurl slowly until your back arches slightly.
avoid: Bending at the hips instead of curling.
rangeOfMotion: Back slightly arched → spine fully curled

name: Standing Cable Crunch
why: Cable crunch done standing, back to the pulley.
setup: Rope on a high pulley. Stand with your back to it.
Rope over your shoulders, hands at your upper chest.
form: Curl your ribs down toward your hips.
Uncurl slowly until you stand tall.
avoid: Bending at the hips or knees instead of curling.
rangeOfMotion: Standing tall → spine fully curled

name: Machine Crunch
why: Loaded crunch on a machine: simple to push hard.
setup: Set the seat so the pads sit on your chest or upper arms.
Feet under the foot pads.
form: Curl your chest down toward your knees.
Come back up slowly until the weight almost touches.
rangeOfMotion: Upright → spine fully curled

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
why: Reverse crunch with cable weight on the ankles.
setup: Ankle straps on a low pulley. Lie on your back, feet toward it.
Knees bent 90°, thighs straight up.
form: Curl your hips off the floor, knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly.
avoid: Letting the cable pull your legs straight.
rangeOfMotion: Hips on the floor → hips curled up

name: Cable Oblique Crunch
aliases: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
why: Cable crunch with a twist: obliques.
setup: Rope on a high pulley. Kneel facing it, hands by your ears.
form: Curl down and turn, elbow toward the opposite knee.
Come up slowly; switch sides each rep.
rangeOfMotion: Upright → spine curled and turned

name: Crunch
why: Basic crunch: short curl of the upper spine.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat or on a bench or ball.
Fingertips by your head, or arms overhead (harder).
form: Curl your shoulders off the floor, ribs toward hips.
Lower slowly.
avoid: Lifting your lower back off the floor.
rangeOfMotion: Shoulders down → shoulders curled up

name: Weighted Crunch
why: Crunch with a plate or ball for added weight.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Plate or ball on your chest, or arms straight up with it.
form: Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.
avoid: Lifting your lower back off the floor.
rangeOfMotion: Shoulders down → shoulders curled up

name: Stability Ball Crunch
why: Crunch over a ball: abs work from a stretch.
setup: Lower back on the ball, feet flat, knees bent.
Let your upper back drape back over the ball.
form: Curl your ribs up toward your hips.
Lower back over the ball to the stretch.
avoid: Rolling the ball instead of curling.
rangeOfMotion: Back arched over the ball → spine curled

name: Decline Crunch
why: Crunch on a decline bench: harder than the floor.
setup: Feet locked in on a decline bench, lie back.
Fingertips by your head.
form: Curl your shoulders up, lower back stays down.
Lower slowly.
avoid: Sitting all the way up (the hips take over).
rangeOfMotion: Shoulders down → shoulders curled up

name: Tuck Crunch
why: Crunch with the legs held up.
setup: Lie on your back, thighs straight up, ankles crossed.
Hands by your sides or your head.
form: Curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
Lower slowly; legs stay up.
rangeOfMotion: Shoulders down → shoulders curled up

name: Sit-Up
why: Full curl from lying to sitting.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet anchored.
Hands by your head or crossed on your chest.
form: Curl up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly, one part of the back at a time.
rangeOfMotion: Lying flat → chest near knees

name: Janda Sit-Up
why: Sit-up with the backs of the legs tight: less hip, more abs.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent 90°, feet flat.
Arms crossed on your chest.
form: Press your heels down, tighten your glutes, curl up slowly.
Lower slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Lying flat → sitting up

name: V-Up
why: Arms and legs meet over the hips.
setup: Lie flat, arms overhead, legs straight.
form: Lift arms and legs together; reach for your feet.
Lower both slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Lying flat → hands near feet

name: Press Sit-Up
why: Sit-up while pressing a light bar overhead.
setup: Lie on an ab bench, feet locked, light barbell on your chest.
form: Sit up and press the bar overhead as you rise.
Lie back slowly, bringing the bar back to your chest.
avoid: Heavy weight: the bar passes over your face.
rangeOfMotion: Lying, bar on chest → sitting, bar overhead

name: Reverse Crunch
why: Hips curl up toward the ribs.
setup: Lie on your back, hands by your sides.
Thighs straight up, knees bent.
form: Curl your hips off the floor, knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly.
tips: Straighten your legs more to make it harder.
rangeOfMotion: Hips on the floor → hips curled up

preferred.why: Lower-ab pick: the hips curl up, and it is easy to make harder.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
why: Reverse crunch on a decline bench: harder.
setup: Lie on a decline bench, head at the top, grip the bench behind your head.
Legs out, knees slightly bent.
form: Bring your knees to your chest and curl your hips up.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
rangeOfMotion: Legs out → hips curled up

name: Lying Leg Pull-In
why: Knees pulled in from straight legs, lying down.
setup: Lie on a bench or mat, legs straight, hands under your hips or gripping the bench.
form: Pull your knees to your chest.
Straighten your legs slowly without touching down.
rangeOfMotion: Legs straight → knees to chest

name: Seated Knee Tuck
why: Knees and chest come together, sitting on a bench.
setup: Sit on the bench edge, grip the sides, lean back about 45°.
Legs straight out, feet off the floor.
form: Pull your knees in as you bring your chest toward them.
Straighten out slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Legs straight → knees to chest

name: Lying Leg Raise
why: Straight-leg raise lying on a bench.
setup: Lie on a bench, legs off the end, hands gripping the bench.
form: Raise straight legs until they point up.
Lower slowly to just above level.
tips: Curl your hips up a little at the top for more abs.
rangeOfMotion: Legs level → legs pointing up

name: Hanging Leg Raise
why: Hard leg raise from a bar.
setup: Hang from a bar, arms straight, legs together.
form: Raise your legs until your hips curl up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
tips: Bend your knees to make it easier.
avoid: Only lifting the legs, without curling the hips.
rangeOfMotion: Hanging straight → hips curled, legs up

preferred.why: Leg-raise pick to pair with a loaded crunch: the hips curl up against the legs' weight.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
why: Easier hanging raise with bent knees.
setup: Hang from a bar, arms straight.
form: Bring your knees up to your chest, curling your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs hang straight.
rangeOfMotion: Hanging straight → knees to chest

name: Hanging Pike
why: Hanging raise all the way to the bar.
setup: Hang from a bar, overhand grip, legs together.
form: Raise your legs until your feet near the bar.
Lower slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Hanging straight → feet near the bar

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
why: Knee raise with your forearms on pads.
setup: Forearms on the pads, back against the back pad, legs hanging.
form: Bring your knees up and curl your hips off the pad.
Lower slowly until your legs hang.
avoid: Stopping with the knees at hip height.
rangeOfMotion: Legs hanging → knees to chest

name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
why: Reverse crunch with a Smith bar on your feet.
setup: Bench under a Smith bar. Lie back, soles of your feet against the bar.
Unrack and straighten your legs.
form: Push the bar up by curling your hips off the bench.
Lower your hips slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Hips on the bench → hips curled up

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
why: Abs stop your back from sagging as you stretch out.
setup: Kneel, hands on the wheel under your shoulders.
form: Roll forward slowly as far as you can without your back sagging.
Pull back with your abs to the start.
avoid: Rolling with the arms while the hips stay high.
rangeOfMotion: Kneeling, wheel under shoulders → body stretched out

name: Barbell Rollout
why: Ab wheel rollout with a lightly loaded barbell.
setup: Small plates on a barbell. Kneel, hands on the bar under your shoulders.
form: Roll forward slowly as far as you can without your back sagging.
Pull back with your abs to the start.
rangeOfMotion: Kneeling, bar under shoulders → body stretched out

name: Barbell Rollout on Toes
why: Hardest rollout: from your toes.
setup: Small plates on a barbell. Push-up position on your toes, hands on the bar.
form: Roll the bar forward as far as you can, back flat.
Pull back with your abs, hips rising.
rangeOfMotion: Hips high → body stretched out

name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
why: Rollout kneeling on a bench, bar on the floor.
setup: Kneel on the end of a bench, hands on a loaded bar on the floor.
form: Roll the bar forward, reaching your arms out overhead.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
rangeOfMotion: Bar under shoulders → arms overhead, body long

name: Dead Bug
why: Slow arm and leg reaches with the lower back flat.
setup: Lie on your back, arms straight up, hips and knees bent 90°.
Press your lower back into the floor.
form: Lower one arm and the opposite leg slowly toward the floor.
Bring them back; switch sides.
avoid: Lower back lifting off the floor.
rangeOfMotion: Arms and legs up → opposite arm and leg near the floor

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
why: Bending sideways against a dumbbell: obliques.
setup: Stand tall, dumbbell in one hand, other hand on your hip.
form: Bend sideways toward the dumbbell.
Come back up past straight, a little toward the other side.
rangeOfMotion: Bent toward the weight → bent slightly away

preferred.why: Top-rated oblique pick: easy to load through a full range.

name: Barbell Side Bend
why: Side bend with a bar on your back.
setup: Bar on your upper back like a squat, feet hip-width.
form: Bend sideways slowly.
Come back up; alternate sides.
avoid: Heavy weight: the bar shifts on your back.
rangeOfMotion: Upright → bent to the side

name: High Cable Side Bend
why: Side crunch against a high cable.
setup: Handle on a high pulley. Stand side-on, handle by your shoulder, elbow down.
form: Bend sideways, ribs toward your hip on the handle side.
Come back up slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Upright → bent toward the handle side

name: Cross-Body Crunch
why: Crunch with a twist toward the opposite knee.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands by your head.
form: Curl up and turn, elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
avoid: Pulling your head with your hands.
rangeOfMotion: Shoulders down → shoulders up and turned

name: Bicycle Crunch
why: Twisting crunch with a pedaling leg motion.
setup: Lie on your back, hands by your head, shoulders and knees up.
form: Bring one elbow to the opposite knee as the other leg straightens.
Switch sides slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Elbow to one knee → elbow to the other knee

name: Heel Touch
why: Small side bends lying down.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and apart.
Shoulders slightly off the floor, arms by your sides.
form: Bend sideways to touch one heel.
Bend to the other heel.
rangeOfMotion: One heel → the other heel

name: Side-Lying Oblique Crunch
why: Crunch lying on your side.
setup: Lie on your side, knees slightly bent, top hand behind your head.
form: Lift your top shoulder toward your hip.
Lower slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Lying on your side → shoulder lifted to the side

name: Side Jackknife
why: Side crunch with the top leg lifting too.
setup: Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked, top hand behind your head.
form: Raise your top leg and upper body toward each other.
Lower both slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Lying on your side → leg and shoulder raised

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
why: Twisting crunch on a decline bench.
setup: Feet locked on a decline bench, upper body raised partway.
One hand by your head, the other on your thigh.
form: Curl up and turn, elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly to the start.
rangeOfMotion: Partway up → curled and turned

name: Cable Woodchop
why: Turning the trunk against a cable, high to low.
setup: Handle on a high pulley. Stand side-on, both hands on it, arms straight.
form: Turn your chest and pull the handle down across your body to the far hip.
Return slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Hands up by the pulley → hands past the far hip

name: Cable Low-to-High Woodchop
why: Turning the trunk against a cable, low to high.
setup: Handle on a low pulley. Stand side-on, both hands on it, arms straight.
form: Turn your chest and lift the handle up across your body.
Return slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Hands low by the pulley → hands above the far shoulder

name: Pallof Press
why: Abs keep the cable from turning you.
setup: Handle on a cable at chest height. Stand side-on, handle at your chest.
form: Press straight out and hold 2 s; don't let it turn you.
Bring it back to your chest.
rangeOfMotion: Handle at chest → arms straight out
tempo: Out 1 s · Hold 2 s · In 1 s

name: Pallof Press with Rotation
why: Trunk turns away from a side cable, arms straight.
setup: Handle on a cable at shoulder height. Stand side-on, arms straight out toward it.
form: Turn your chest away from the cable, arms straight.
Turn back slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Facing the cable → turned away

name: Cable Russian Twist
why: Twist on a ball against a side cable.
setup: Cable at mid height. Shoulders on a ball, side-on to the cable.
Arms straight up, both hands on the handle.
form: Turn your shoulders away from the cable.
Turn back slowly.
rangeOfMotion: Facing up → turned away from the cable

name: Russian Twist
why: Seated side-to-side twist.
setup: Sit leaning back, knees bent, feet anchored or up.
Arms out in front.
form: Turn your shoulders to one side.
Turn to the other side.
rangeOfMotion: Turned to one side → turned to the other

name: Plate Twist
why: Russian twist with a plate.
setup: Sit leaning back, feet off the floor, plate in front of your stomach.
form: Turn your shoulders and bring the plate to one side.
Turn to the other side.
rangeOfMotion: Turned to one side → turned to the other

name: Seated Barbell Twist
why: Seated twist with a light bar on your back.
setup: Sit at the end of a bench, light bar on your upper back.
form: Turn your shoulders to one side, hips still.
Turn to the other side.
rangeOfMotion: Turned to one side → turned to the other

name: Landmine Rotation
why: Bar swings side to side as the trunk turns.
setup: Bar in a landmine. Stand wide, end of the bar at shoulder height, arms straight.
form: Turn your trunk and hips to bring the bar down to one hip.
Turn through to the other side.
rangeOfMotion: Bar by one hip → bar by the other hip

name: Rotary Torso Machine
why: Seated twist on a machine.
setup: Sit with your chest against the pad, legs locked in.
Set the range to a comfortable twist.
form: Turn your shoulders to one side, hips still.
Turn back slowly; train the other side next set.
rangeOfMotion: Facing forward → turned to the side
